mission: Provide a local-first AI agent platform that runs on hardware the operator controls, with persistent identity, memory, and voice.
purpose: Public digital-engineering evidence for OtaconsKeep, not a sales SOW. Status colors mean readiness and honesty, not marketing.
tagline: Evidence board · local-first AI agents · no fabricated PASS
operational_concept: Operator installs Core locally (Windows one-click via OtaconsKeep-Setup.bat or Linux/WSL), receives a Command Center with Codec chat, optional Default Model via Ollama sized to VRAM, and Genome Voice Trainer. Agents persist conversation and long-term memory on local storage. Optional integrations use operator-owned credentials.

Full multi-node GPU media farm as automatic Expansion READY
Antonio's private infrastructure accounts or secrets
